verdict.rationale: Maritime documents a RESTful API for managing agents programmatically, authenticated with Bearer personal API keys (the same token the CLI uses). It adds scoped keys, signed lifecycle webhooks, an eight-endpoint Files API, and TypeScript/Python SDKs with idempotent provisioning, so the core of the story is clearly delivered. The probe found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec at any standard path, which weakens machine discoverability but does not contradict the API's existence. Missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of the REST API.
